description: We are Musuq Pacha Tech, a Peruvian team interested in astronomy, education, technology, and innovation with Andean identity. Our skills include web development, 3D design, research, writing, storytelling, audiovisual production, artificial intelligence, and content organization. We are interested in creating experiences that bring science closer to children, young people, and the general public in a visual, accessible, and engaging way. New members will have the opportunity to contribute ideas
